name: Cahya Mata Sarawak Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项；公告主要涉及季度业绩、股东大会、股份分拆上市、诉讼及董事委员会成员变动。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract wins for its business segments in its announcements; announcements mainly covered quarterly results, general meetings, share subdivision listings, litigation, and changes in board committee membership.
